summary: EducationSuperHighway provides a summary of the modernized E-Rate program and its benefits, opposing any sunset of the program. The comment argues for preserving the E-Rate program based on its success in connecting schools to broadband and the cost-effectiveness of the program. It cites evidence that 99.3% of schools have a high-speed broadband connection and that the program has helped reduce the cost per megabit for school districts. The comment discusses the ongoing need for E-Rate support, noting that the program is cost-effective and has been successful in improving connectivity in schools and libraries. It highlights the importance of maintaining the program to ensure continued access to broadband services for educational purposes. The comment opposes limiting or sunsetting the E-Rate program, emphasizing the need for funding to maintain reliable internet connections for schools and libraries, particularly in high-poverty and rural areas. The comment cites evidence from GAO reports on the impact of cybersecurity incidents on education and the importance of broadband access for educational equity.
